description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the local Qwen-Image 2.1 model. Dimensions are chosen automatically (aspect ratio can be inferred from the prompt, e.g. '16:9 hero image') unless width/height or aspect_ratio are given. Returns the absolute path of the saved PNG. Runs fully offline; typically 45 s–4 min.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, or auto (inferred from the prompt)

height.description: Output height in pixels (needs width too).

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

prompt.description: What to generate, in natural language

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

width.description: Output width in pixels (needs height too). Omit to choose automatically.

name: generate_image
title: Generate image
